goal.vi: Đưa ra mức lương có căn cứ, hỏi về sự linh hoạt, xin thêm thời gian và nhận lời một cách thiện chí.
goal.en: Ask for a fair number, check if there is room to move, ask for time and accept on good terms.

lines: We'd like to offer you the job at 70,000 a year.
Thank you! I'm really excited about this offer.
Based on my research, the range for this role is 70 to 80 thousand. I was hoping for something closer to 78.
I understand. 78 is above our budget, I'm afraid.
Is there any flexibility on the base salary?
If the salary is fixed at 74, could we talk about extra vacation days?
We can add five more days.
That sounds fair. Could I have a day to think it over?
Of course. Let us know by Friday.

phrases.say: Based on my research, the range for this role is 70 to 80 thousand.

mean.vi: Đưa ra mức lương dựa trên tìm hiểu thị trường
mean.en: Give a number based on facts

why.vi: Dẫn số liệu khiến đề nghị của bạn nghe công bằng.
why.en: Facts and numbers make your request sound fair.

phrases.say: I was hoping for something closer to 78.
phrases.not: This salary is too low for me.

mean.vi: Nói mức bạn mong muốn một cách mềm mỏng
mean.en: Say the number you want in a soft way

why.vi: "I was hoping for…" vừa kiên quyết vừa nhẹ nhàng.
why.en: "I was hoping for…" is firm but soft.

phrases.say: Is there any flexibility on the base salary?
phrases.not: You can give more or not?

mean.vi: Hỏi xem còn thương lượng được không
mean.en: Ask if there is room to change the offer

why.vi: Câu hỏi mở này mở ra cuộc trao đổi, không chỉ có/không.
why.en: This opens a talk, not just a yes or no.

phrases.say: I'm really excited about this offer.
phrases.not: I am very exciting for this offer.

mean.vi: Cảm ơn và thể hiện bạn rất vui với lời mời
mean.en: Thank them and show you are happy

why.vi: "Excited" là cảm xúc của bạn; "exciting" mô tả sự việc.
why.en: "Excited" is how you feel; "exciting" describes the thing.

phrases.say: If the salary is fixed, could we talk about extra vacation days?

mean.vi: Đề nghị lợi ích khác khi lương không tăng được
mean.en: Ask for other things if the money can't change

why.vi: Nếu lương không đổi được, hãy hỏi về quyền lợi khác.
why.en: If money can't move, ask for other things you value.

phrases.say: Could I have a day or two to think it over?
phrases.not: I must think. I answer later.

mean.vi: Xin thêm thời gian để suy nghĩ

why.vi: Xin thời gian suy nghĩ là bình thường và cho thấy bạn cẩn thận.
why.en: Asking for time is normal and shows you are careful.

phrases.say: That sounds fair. I'm happy to accept the offer.

mean.vi: Nhận lời mời làm việc một cách vui vẻ

why.vi: Nói "agree to" một đề nghị, hoặc đơn giản là "accept".
why.en: Say "agree to" an offer, or simply say "accept".

ai.name: Karen
ai.role: an HR manager at a marketing company
ai.persona: friendly but careful with the budget
ai.goal: agree on a salary inside the company's budget

roleplay.you: Thank her for the offer, ask for a higher number with a reason, ask if they can offer more or give other benefits, then ask for time to decide.

turns.a: We'd like to offer you the job at 70,000 a year.
turns.h: Thank you! I'm really excited about this offer.

turns.a: So, what do you think about the salary?
turns.h: Based on my research, I was hoping for something closer to 78.
br: I see. That's above our budget, I'm afraid.

turns.a: We could go up to 74, but that's our limit.
turns.h: If the salary is fixed, could we talk about extra vacation days?
br: We could add five more days.

turns.a: So, do we have a deal?
turns.h: That sounds fair. Could I have a day to think it over?

roleplay.end: Take your time. Just let us know by Friday. We really hope you'll join us!
